summary: BranchOut Food Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an additional $1M borrowing from Kaufman Kapital LLC under an amended secured promissory note, increasing total principal to $4M. The note matures January 28, 2027, bears 8% interest, and is secured on substantially all assets. Proceeds are for working capital to fulfill customer orders. This is a routine debt amendment, not a special situation — no equity, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event involved.
